prompts.name: main-menu-v1.png
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: polished main-menu screen concept for an original native Windows 2D cooperative roguelike game, one full-screen 16:9 landscape image.
Primary request: design the GAME INTERFACE itself, with professional indie adventure game art direction, not a character illustration, not individual texture assets, not a website.
Composition: full-bleed atmospheric hand-painted game backdrop of an empty hexagonal stone expedition chamber, distant misty interconnected hexagonal rooms, subtle teal light in the distance. Elevated diagonal view, understated detail. The left third has a calm dark gradient for superb text readability; scene dominates the center and right. No hero portrait, no visible warrior, no enemies. Generous whitespace and clear visual hierarchy.
UI: game title "HSMultiplayer" large and elegant near the upper-left, warm ivory lettering, subtle engraved brass accent. Below it, exactly THREE large stacked buttons, each spacious with restrained chamfered slate frames, fine aged-brass edges, precise pale text. First button in a quiet teal hover state. Exact Simplified Chinese button labels: "开始游戏", "设置", "退出". No other buttons anywhere. A tiny noninteractive "0.6.0" in the bottom-right is allowed.
Style: cohesive premium hand-painted 2D fantasy adventure UI, practical and buildable, dark desaturated navy/slate, aged brass, restrained turquoise, warm ivory typography. Delicate material textures on borders; clean large interiors rather than ornate curls. Crisp legible Chinese, even spacing, strong contrast, 48px-safe margins. Art directs attention toward the Start button.
Avoid: website navigation, device frames, explanatory callouts, a sheet of multiple screens, hero character art, oversized statues, logos from existing games, extra menu options, store, battle pass, login, social buttons, huge cluttered ornament. Only one complete proposed game main-menu design.

prompts.name: preparation-hall-v1.png
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: one complete 16:9 desktop game preparation-hall UI design, not an asset sheet, not a website.
Reference image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: reuse its slate stone, restrained brass edges, teal light, ivory Chinese typography and hand-painted adventure atmosphere. Create a NEW spatial layout, do not copy the main-menu composition or buttons.
Primary request: design a WALKABLE PERSONAL PREPARATION HALL for the same 2D multiplayer roguelike. This is a game interface design concept, the small playable avatar is secondary.
Scene: a large complete hexagonal stone chamber seen in a readable elevated diagonal 2D view, fine subtle hexagonal floor grid. Open walking space in the center. Around its perimeter place six modest interactive facilities: a single-player expedition gate (one-person icon), room-settings console (cog icon), meta-growth lectern (branching tree icon), multiplayer hosting gate (group icon), server-joining beacon (connection icon), warehouse chest (box icon). Each is a real object in the room with a small tasteful icon marker. Only ONE tiny neutral player avatar near the room-settings console; no heroic portrait, no character-focused illustration. No name labels constantly over every device.
UI: a slim upper-left title reads "个人大厅", beside a small player chip "玩家" and "战士机体". Upper-right a small gold-point icon followed by "12", with subtle label "局外点数"; beside it a compact settings cog marked "Esc". At the bottom, restrained guidance "走近装置后按 G 交互". No quest tracker, chat box or monetization.
A draggable NORMAL WINDOW is open on the right, occupying no more than 27 percent of the screen and leaving the walking chamber readable. Header "房间设置", with a small close X at top-right and subtle drag handle. Clean readable rows: "人数上限" value "8"; "投票门槛" value "70%"; "特殊模式" value "关闭". A section "初始机体" with three compact icon choices labelled "侦察", "秘法", "战士", warrior option outlined in teal. The footer uses ONLY a small save-disk icon and a cancel X icon, not a large Start button.
Near the room-settings device, a small mouse-bound READ-ONLY hover tooltip shows exactly "房间设置" and, because Shift is held, "调整人数、投票与开局选项". It has no close icon, no confirmation controls, no drag handle. Keep this tooltip separate from the real window. One nearby device interaction prompt may show "G".
Art direction: premium buildable indie adventure UI; thin chamfered navy/slate panels, brass fine-line borders, very subtle teal hover glow, generous breathing room, sharp Simplified Chinese typography. Same cohesive visual language as the reference but brighter readable floor. Present a single final-looking full-screen interface proposal, with no explanatory arrows, external labels, browser chrome or reference sheet. No changes to gameplay rules, no additional currencies or mandatory ready checks.

prompts.name: combat-hud-v1.png
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: ONE complete widescreen 16:9 in-game COMBAT HUD design proposal for a native Windows 2D cooperative roguelike.
Reference image 1 is style reference ONLY: match the slate/aged-brass/teal/ivory art direction, refined thin chamfered frames and Chinese typography. Create a new gameplay screen, NOT another menu and NOT character art.
World: the combat scene fills the ENTIRE screen behind the HUD, no opaque sidebars. A broad hexagonal stone arena, subtle hexagonal floor grid, viewed from a clear elevated diagonal 2D camera, connected rooms glimpsed through archways. Keep central 65 percent unobstructed. Two tiny generic player silhouettes, a few small monsters and readable projectile traces suggest actual play; all secondary to the interface design. Do NOT feature a warrior portrait. Quiet floor contrast so the controls and characters read.
STRICT HUD PLACEMENT, preserve every item:
1. UPPER LEFT: four compact square SKILL icon slots in a horizontal row, with distinct shield/lightning/burst/heart symbols, small keyboard badges "Q", "E", "R", "F". One cooling-down skill shows "3.2" and a subtle radial dark mask. No written skill names on the slots.
2. Directly BELOW that row: four compact CONSUMABLE icon slots, potion/scroll symbols, keyboard badges "1", "2", "3", "4"; a small stack count "12" on a potion. No names on these slots.
3. Directly BELOW these: a quiet small currency/growth strip, gold coin icon with "248", "等级 3", narrow gold XP bar. This is information, not a big menu.
4. UPPER RIGHT: a small framed hexagonal MINIMAP; in its INNER BOTTOM LEFT show "个人 4 · 共享 3". Directly below minimap a compact camera-view icon control with small "Tab" key badge; directly below that, TWO TEAMMATE STATUS rows with small avatar icons, names "队友 A" and "队友 B", slim health bars and "同房间" / "其他房间". The same-room teammate is placed first and has a distinctive teal border; the other border is muted.
5. BOTTOM CENTER: health bar showing "132.00 / 150.00" and below it a slim violet resource bar "73 / 100". Exactly TWO dodge indicators as circular dots on the RIGHT of the health bar: one filled teal dot, one dim hollow dot. Do not put dodge dots in a separate corner.
6. ABOVE the bottom-center resource bars: a small row of STATUS ICONS, ONLY icon + whole-status level + remaining time on each. Example badges "2 · 8s", "1 · 12s". No permanent descriptions.
7. LOWER RIGHT: three compact icon-only controls: current weapon sword icon, armor/shield icon, backpack icon with "B" key badge. No permanent word labels.
8. TOP CENTER: a restrained small information plaque, exact text "第 1 / 3 层" and "波次 2 / 3", away from central action.
9. Lower left one small settings cog with "Esc".
Demonstrate a READ-ONLY HOVER tooltip attached to a small mouse cursor over one status icon near the bottom: tooltip above and slightly to the left of the status row without covering the character. Header "迅捷"; short rows "层数 2", "剩余 8.0 秒", "移动速度 +20%"; a separated detail line "基础 170 × (1 + 20%) = 204" because Shift is held. A tiny "Shift" hint is okay. Tooltip has NO close X, NO buttons, NO tabs, NO drag handle. It must look like a compact information card rather than a normal window.
Visual style: crisp readable polished game UI, practical reusable components, restrained ornament and fine brass dividers. Deep navy translucent panels, pale ivory text, gold for currency and numbers, teal for team/selection, rose health, violet energy. Icons are clear hand-painted game UI symbols. Consistent padding and margins, all Chinese text carefully typeset, keep text horizontal despite the game camera. No long explanatory paragraphs or external callouts. No new game mechanics, no quest list, no chat, no boss health bar, no hotbar across bottom, no decorative character portrait panel. Deliver a full-screen visual DESIGN, not a screenshot of code or a browser.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit the provided preparation-hall interface design. Change ONLY the three small initial-chassis selection symbols inside the right-hand "房间设置" window: above "侦察" draw an unmistakable small bow-and-arrow icon; above "秘法" draw an unmistakable crystal-tipped magic staff icon; above the highlighted "战士" draw an unmistakable short SWORD AND ROUND SHIELD icon. The warrior must not have a crossbow.
Match the existing thin ivory/brass line-icon style and each card's current icon size. Keep all Chinese labels, card dimensions, selection highlight, window controls, values, scene, lights, background, character, hover tooltip and every other pixel/composition element unchanged as closely as possible. No new labels or objects. Preserve the full 16:9 design and opaque background.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit the provided combat HUD design. Make ONLY these two small corrections, preserve everything else:
1. Inside the existing TOP-RIGHT MINIMAP frame, replace the current squared-corridor interior with a small adventure map made of distinct regular HEXAGONAL cells, about 12 to 16 cells. Dark slate cells, a few thin connector lines between selected adjacent hexagons, some disconnected cliff cells, and the same teal player marker. A few tiny shop/exit symbols are acceptable. Keep the outer minimap frame, its size, position, top N compass mark and bottom text "个人 4 · 共享 3" exactly in place. This is a six-sided hexagon node map, never square rooms or corridors.
2. In the BOTTOM STATUS ROW the RIGHTMOST gold SHIELD icon currently has the badge "1 · 6s". Replace that badge with exactly "6s" because shields have duration but NO status level. Keep the shield icon and its slot size and position unchanged. Other status badges remain "2 · 8s" and "1 · 12s".
Keep all other text, every HUD position, the read-only Shift tooltip and formula, health/energy/dodge dots, inventory icons, scene and characters unchanged as closely as possible. Preserve full 16:9 composition and opaque background.
